summary: Iteration 9 tested 3 features: role/branch sign-in, coordinator branch isolation + bulk approve, and pass reminder emails. Backend: 23/23 new pytest tests pass, and 35/35 regression tests pass (test_olam_api, test_settings_faculty). Frontend (390x844): staff login role/branch picker, coordinator branch check, MUVATTUPUZHA coordinator dashboard, bulk select/approve and the event-settings reminder card all work. One HIGH real-world problem: the email provider returns 429 (rate limited). Once that starts, every remaining reminder and pass email is dropped, nothing retries, and the UI still says 'Sending N reminder emails now'. I reproduced it twice: 6/6 reminders failed (0 sent), and 1 of 3 bulk-approve pass emails failed. No deprecated Expo packages were found in the files reviewed.

critical.issue: The email provider (integrations.emergentagent.com email/send) returns 429 'email rate limit exceeded' after roughly 8-10 emails in a short window. _send_email logs a warning and returns False with no retry or backoff. Result: reminders stay unsent (pending is unchanged, 'Reminder emails sent: 0' in the log), and pass emails from bulk approve are silently lost, with no record and no way to resend. Bulk-approving 50 students will lose most of their pass emails. Reproduced twice: at 14:13:58 all 6 reminders got 429, and again at 14:15:50 after waiting 75s. In the bulk run of 3, 1 pass email got 429.

minor.issue: Grammar: 'This account is a Admin account' should be 'an Admin account'. Use the right article or rephrase, e.g. 'This is an Admin account. Please choose Admin to sign in.'

The update_one filter is only {id}. It does not include status:'pending', so two concurrent approve or bulk calls can both pass the status check and call _issue_pass twice. A second pass version can make the first emailed token stale. Use an atomic find_one_and_update with {id, status:'pending'}.
The 'queued' count is computed before the background task runs, so it is reported as if sent even when every send fails. There is no last-run result (sent/failed) the UI can show.

ui_bugs.issue: After 'Save reminder settings' with a new event date, the reminder-status text and the Send button count stay stale (they still showed '3 reminded • 3 still to remind'; after a reload it was '0 reminded • 6'). loadReminder() is only called on mount and once 4s after send. Call loadReminder() after save() succeeds, and poll after send until pending stops changing.
The message is always green ('Sending 6 reminder emails now') even when the backend fails every email (429). Errors from sendNow also show in the success color.

integration_issues.issue: Provider 429 failures are invisible to the admin. The UI claims emails are on their way.

issues: The coordinator eyebrow 'MUVATTUPUZHA • COORDINATOR' is cut off as 'MUVATTUPUZHA • COOR…' because the Password/Sign out buttons take the space. Allow 2 lines, shorten it, or move the actions.
The select-reg-{id} checkbox is 32x32. hitSlop has no effect on web, so the touch target is under 44px.

action_items: HIGH: Make email sending robust to provider 429. Retry with exponential backoff and honor Retry-After, or use a persistent queue (e.g. an email_outbox collection with status pending/sent/failed and a retry worker). Throttle well below the provider limit; 0.6s spacing is not enough. Record pass_email_sent_at / failed on the registration, and add a 'resend pass email' action.
Have /reminders/status (or a last_run doc) expose sent/failed counts from the last run, and show failures in event-settings instead of a green 'Sending N' message.
event-settings: call loadReminder() after a successful save, and poll status after send until it completes.
Fix the login 403 grammar ('a Admin' -> 'an Admin').
Make the approval atomic: update with filter {id, status:'pending'} and only issue a pass if the update modified a document.
Dashboard: fix the cut-off coordinator eyebrow at 390px, and make the bulk checkbox touch target 44x44.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1458 lines. Split it into routers (auth, settings/reminders, registrations, scan, staff, reports).

PUT /api/settings replaces every field. A client that leaves out event_date/auto_reminder will wipe the event date and reset auto_reminder to True. Consider a PATCH, or keep existing values when a field is omitted.
_reminder_loop marks auto_reminder_done_for before sending, so if every send fails (429) the automatic day-before reminder is never retried.
Wrong password still returns a generic 401 with no role/branch hints. The role/branch checks only run after password verification, which is good.

success_rate.backend: 100% (23/23 new + 35/35 regression); email delivery limited by provider 429
success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all flows work; 2 reminder UI state bugs, 2 design issues)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ registrations (@resend.dev emails) and test_ staff. All removed with cleanup_test_data.py. The settings doc was deleted, so registration is open. qa-admin and owner were kept.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the external URL. Restart the backend before running tests (in-memory rate limits). The email provider rate-limits at about 8-10 emails per short window, so space email-heavy tests out. Real registrations: OLM-E04B9A and OLM-7A2076 were rejected by the OWNER account (u-e148b11b36ed, reason 'not valid') at 14:15 during this run, according to audit_logs. That was not done by the tests, so all 5 real ones are now 'rejected'. Do not restore them.
rca_of_issue: Reminder/pass email loss: _send_email -> provider HTTP 429 'email rate limit exceeded' -> returns False with no retry. _send_reminders leaves reminder_sent_for unset (pending unchanged), and _send_many drops pass emails silently. Repro: bulk-approve 3 students, then send reminders to 6 within about 2 minutes. The backend.err.log shows the 429 warnings and 'Reminder emails sent: 0'. Mitigation: queue + backoff + status tracking.
